svg.text: #583 Enterprise Document Intelligence (IDP): 3-Tier Complexity Router vs. Managed OCR & Pure VLM
Cloud & AI Solution Architect Guide · Page Complexity Router (65% PyMuPDF CPU + 25% MinerU L40S + 10% Qwen2.5-VL-72B H100) · $0.53 / 1K Pages
1. 3-Tier Page Complexity Router (1.5ms CPU Gate)
Tier 1 (65% Pages): Born-Digital PDF Native Text + Simple Vector Tables
• Engine: PyMuPDF (fitz) + Fast BBox Table Reconstructor on CPU
• Speed: 2.0ms/page (500 pages/sec/node) · Cost: $0.02 / 1,000 pages
Tier 2 (25% Pages): Scanned Multi-Column PDFs, Standard Tables & Formulas
• Engine: MinerU / DocLayout-YOLO + PaddleOCR-v4 / Surya on L40S-48GB
• Speed: 85ms/page (11.8 pages/sec/L40S) · Cost: $0.38 / 1,000 pages
Tier 3 (10% Pages): Handwritten, Red-Stamped, Cross-Page Merged Cells
• Engine: OlmOCR-7B / Qwen2.5-VL-72B-FP8 + Guided JSON Schema on H100
• Speed: 1.85s/page · Cost: $4.20 / 1,000 pages (Applied to 10% slice only!)
2. 10M Pages/Month Benchmark & TCO Comparison
A. Managed Cloud Layout OCR (Azure Document Intelligence / AWS Textract)
• Cost: $10.00 / 1K pages → $100,000/mo @ 10M pages · Complex Table F1: 88.5%
B. Naive 100% Frontier VLM (Send Every Page to Qwen2.5-VL-72B on H100)
• Cost: $4.20 / 1K pages → $42,000/mo (18× H100 Fleet) · Complex Table F1: 96.4%
C. 3-Tier Complexity-Routed IDP Pipeline (65 / 25 / 10 Split) [RECOMMENDED]
• Blended Cost: $0.528 / 1,000 pages → $5,280/mo @ 10M pages (-94.7% vs. Cloud API)
• Complex Financial Table Cell F1: 96.8% (Markdown + HTML rowspan/colspan)
• Fleet for 10M Pages/Mo: 2× CPU Nodes + 1× L40S (MinerU) + 2× H100 (VLM Tier 3)
3. Why HTML <table rowspan colspan> Beats Markdown Pipe Tables for Financial RAG
• Markdown pipe tables (| a | b |) cannot represent hierarchical merged headers or multi-row cells, causing 31% RAG numerical attribution errors.
• Emitting HTML <table> with explicit row/column header propagation into each chunk lifts financial QA accuracy from 68.4% to 95.2%.
